WITH trader_trade_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  trade_record_count,
  trade_record_count * 1.0 / SUM(trade_record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM trader_trade_counts;
